sources.description: 2010 SPP Document 202, Section 5.5 (p. 19). Architect may be paid on a per diem and honorarium basis plus out-of-pocket expenses for specific activities. Source: Standards of Professional Practice2.pdf.

sources.label: 2010 SPP Doc. 202, Sec. 7.4 — Per Diem plus traveling/living expenses chargeable when services required beyond 50 km from Architect's established office
sources.description: 2010 SPP Document 202, Section 7.4 (pp. 20-21). Per diem plus traveling and living expenses shall be chargeable to the Owner whenever the Architect is required to perform services at a locality beyond 50.0 km from established office. Source: Standards of Professional Practice2.pdf.
